title: About DarGlobal
text:
## About DarGlobal
DarGlobal is an international luxury real estate developer that works with global partners on homes, communities and destinations. Its approach: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose.
DarGlobal's website cites over 31 years of luxury development experience (including the heritage of its parent Dar Al Arkan).
DarGlobal was founded in 2017 as the international (non-Saudi) arm of Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development, a leading Saudi developer. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.
Leadership: Ziad El Chaar is Founder and Chief Executive Officer. He is also Chairman of Wasalt.
Portfolio: residences, vacation retreats, world-class hospitality, and developments with luxury brands such as Trump, Aston Martin and Lamborghini.
Global presence: sales offices in 9 cities including New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat and Doha. Projects span cities in the UK, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Oman and the Maldives.
Values: quality, people-first thinking, long-term value, agility in adapting to the market.
Contact: sales WhatsApp +971 800 40409; contact form at https://darglobal.co.uk/get-in-touch; investor relations at https://darglobal.co.uk/investor.

title: DarGlobal Hospitality
text:
## Hospitality, revisited
DarGlobal is extending its residential vision into branded hotels, golf resorts and exclusive clubs, each focused on a distinct lifestyle experience. Tagline: crafting experiences that stay.
Hospitality projects and destinations:
- Trump International Hotel, Oman (Muscat)
- Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai (UAE)
- Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives (Noonu Atoll), a luxury hotel with spa
- Trump International Hotel, Wadi Safar, Riyadh (KSA), also linked to Trump Mansions
- SHFT Night Club, Muscat (Oman), entertainment
- The Trump Members-Only Club, Jeddah (KSA)
- The Trump Members-Only Club, Dubai (UAE)
- The Vitality Club, Jeddah (KSA)
DarGlobal also has a real estate debt team that sources and invests in financing opportunities for property owners and developers in its regions of operation.

title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
text:
## Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
Location: Sheikh Zayed Road, at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, near Dubai Mall and the Burj Khalifa district.
Type: branded hotel and residential tower. DarGlobal is the master developer; the project is Trump-branded and described as the first Trump-branded development in the Middle East.
Units: one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments plus four-bedroom duplex penthouses. The page lists sizes of 764 to 7,720 sq ft (FAQ says 109 to 722 sqm; confirm with DarGlobal). Every unit is said to have a sea or Burj Khalifa view.
Status: under development, handover scheduled for December 2031.
Resident amenities: rooftop infinity pool (described as the highest in the world), gym, owners lounge, kids play area.
Members-only club: signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms and a pool; annual fee, with residents getting priority.
Hotel: five-star hotel with fine dining and entertainment.
Pricing is not published; contact the DarGlobal sales team for pricing and payment plans.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah
text:
## Trump Tower Jeddah
Location: Jeddah Corniche, Saudi Arabia, on the Red Sea coast, near the marina, the Formula 1 street circuit and the King Fahd Fountain.
Type: seafront residences in a 47-floor tower, all units facing the Red Sea.
Units: 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-bedroom apartments plus 3- and 4-bedroom penthouses, from 70 to 365 sqm.
Completion: scheduled for December 2029.
Amenities: Trump Private Club for residents and members, 24/7 concierge, fine dining and cigar lounge, meeting rooms, gym and yoga zone, pool, kids pool and jacuzzi.
Ownership: developed and owned by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate. The Trump name is used under licence; The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer or seller.
Investment context cited on the page: 0% personal income tax and capital gains tax in Saudi Arabia, premium residency for investments of SAR 4 million or more, Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA World Cup, SAR pegged to the US dollar.
Pricing is not published; contact the sales team.

title: Trump International Resort Maldives
text:
## Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives
Location: Maldives (Noonu Atoll). Offered by DarGlobal as an exclusive luxury real estate and investment opportunity.
Experiences: on and above water (sailing, surfing, paddle boarding, water skiing, wakeboarding, parasailing, jet ski safaris, sunset dolphin cruises); below the surface (snorkelling, scuba diving, nurse shark and manta ray encounters, turtle snorkelling); wellness (sunrise overwater yoga, floating meditation, lagoon sound healing, private spa rituals, cold plunge, personalised wellness programmes); culinary (overwater fine dining, chef's tasting experience, private beach dining, lagoon sunset bar, champagne and caviar lounge, cigar and whisky room).
Unit types, price and completion date are not stated on the page.

title: About Wasalt
text:
## About Wasalt
Wasalt is a real estate brokerage platform (website and mobile app) in Saudi Arabia, branded 'Your investment partner'. It is a one-stop portal for finding, buying, renting, marketing and listing residential and commercial property.
Wasalt is a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan (leading Saudi developer with over 27 years of experience) and Quara Holding (a technology startup incubator and innovation hub). Dar Al Arkan is also the parent of DarGlobal. Ziad El Chaar is Chairman of Wasalt.
Wasalt describes itself as the first AI-powered real estate platform in Saudi Arabia. Every listing is verified by REGA (Real Estate General Authority) and pricing is meant to be transparent.
Offerings: residential and commercial brokerage, property management and maintenance, financial brokerage support for auction purchases, online tools for viewing and completing transactions, access to property specialists, a choice of mortgage providers, 24/7 sales team support.
Registered in Riyadh, Commercial Registration No. 1010635634.

title: Wasalt - Saudi Arabia real estate platform
text:
## Wasalt services and features
Buy, Rent, Projects and Daily Rentals (new) sections.
AI price predictions and ROI estimates, developed with propgenius.ai.
Matchmaker: a questionnaire that connects users with a broker who matches their requirements.
Communities: browse neighborhoods, plots and prices, with online plot booking.
Auctions: in partnership with Infath (the Entrustment and Liquidation Centre) users can list or bid on government and private property and land auctions online.
Home loan referrals through partner lenders. Interactive maps. Apps on Apple App Store and Google Play.
Property categories: residential for sale (houses, villas, plots), residential for rent (apartments, villas), commercial for sale (shops, offices, plots), commercial for rent (shops, offices).
Search filters: property type, bedrooms, budget, price range, furnished or unfurnished, location.
Cities named: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, with listings across districts throughout Saudi Arabia.
Wasalt also showcases International Luxury properties and publishes real estate guides and articles at blog.wasalt.sa.

title: Wasalt corporate
text:
## Wasalt milestones, licences and products
Milestones: launched in January 2022; Wasalt Auction launched; Wasalt Business became the first real estate app of its kind in Saudi Arabia; Matchmaker Packages launched; Wasalt Business passed 15,000 registered brokers; AI tools introduced; 250,000 registered users in March 2024. Later press coverage reports more than 750,000 registered users and about 100,000 monthly leads.
Licences: licensed by Infath as a real estate auction platform; licensed by REGA as a real estate portal; also listed as a Ministry of Tourism licensed platform for daily rentals.
Products: Wasalt portal (verified properties, projects, masterplans, online auctions, enhanced search); Wasalt Auction; Wasalt Business (a CRM app for brokers to manage tasks, listings, leads and teams; developers and brokers publish via this app); PropGenius AI suite (multilingual property descriptions, social media posts, real-time valuations, ROI prediction, lead generation); Matchmaker Packages.
Ownership: joint venture of Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding.

title: Properties for sale in Saudi Arabia - FAQ
text:
## Buying property in Saudi Arabia (Wasalt FAQ)
Expatriates with valid residency (Iqama) are typically eligible to purchase real estate, especially in designated areas and with proper documentation.
To verify a property, use trusted platforms such as Wasalt where listings are verified, request official title deeds, check municipal approvals and legal status, and consult agents or legal advisors where needed.
Wasalt lists residential and commercial properties for sale and rent across Saudi Arabia, for example hundreds of buildings for sale.

title: DarGlobal and Wasalt relationship
text:
## How DarGlobal and Wasalt are related
Both companies are linked to Dar Al Arkan. DarGlobal is the international luxury real estate developer (London Stock Exchange listed, founded 2017) created to hold Dar Al Arkan's non-Saudi assets. Wasalt is a Saudi proptech brokerage platform, a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding, launched in 2022. Ziad El Chaar is CEO of DarGlobal and Chairman of Wasalt.
